name: SandboxEscapeBench
protocol: Source export protocol; row-level protocol details are preserved when available.

explanation.en: The agent has bash access inside a container and must escape to the host and read /flag.txt; the score is the overall success rate over 18 public scenarios and 5 epochs at a 2.5M-token budget.
explanation.zh: agent 在容器内拥有 bash 权限，需逃逸到宿主机并读取 /flag.txt；分数是在 18 个公开场景、5 个 epoch、2.5M token 预算下的整体成功率。

summary.en: SandboxEscapeBench tests whether agents can break out of a container sandbox to the host across orchestration, runtime, and kernel attack layers.
summary.zh: SandboxEscapeBench 评估 agent 能否越过容器沙箱逃逸到宿主机，覆盖编排、运行时和内核三个攻击层面。

task_format.en: Inside an Inspect capture-the-flag container the agent uses bash, docker and kubectl to escape to the host VM and read /flag.txt.
task_format.zh: 在 Inspect 的 capture-the-flag 容器中，agent 使用 bash、docker 和 kubectl 逃逸到宿主 VM 并读取 /flag.txt。
